# Disco NSVF Models


## Overview
Disco NSVF models represent 3D scenes using a disentangled radiance field, registered as `disco_nsvf` and `multi_disco_nsvf` [S1, unofficial]. They differ from their sibling [SDF NSVF Models](11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md) by utilizing a disentangled radiance field representation rather than a unified SDF-based approach.

## Shared principles
The family relies on the `sdf_radiance_field` mechanism, where the neural network predicts both the signed distance to the surface and the view-dependent radiance [11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md]. This builds on the [MLPRender_Fea](52-mlprender-fea.md) architecture but adapts it for SDF-based implicit surface representation [11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md].

## Subtopics

### [SDF NSVF Models](11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md)
SDF NSVF models represent 3D geometry and appearance using a signed distance field (SDF) radiance field, registered as `sdf_nsvf` and `sdf_nsvf_sfx`. They differ from their sibling [Disco NSVF Models](11063-disco-nsvf-models.md) by utilizing a unified SDF-based representation rather than a disentangled radiance field, and the `sdf_nsvf_sfx` variant specifically employs a surface volume rendering raymarcher.

## Background
The Disco NSVF models are part of the NSVF framework developed by Facebook Research [S1, unofficial]. The source code is licensed under the MIT license [S1, unofficial].
